Row.Text: [B]Specialists[/B] were an important part of [B]Joseon's[/B] identity.

Cities have grown large, and stratified. A thousand different trades mix on the streets, and a thousand everyday conflicts and contestations erupt. In this confusion, a group of scholars calls for order: a structured society, where all work for a common good, and all know their place.
[B]Joseon[/B] is able to endure throughout the Ages.
[B]Yi Sun-sin[/B] lead [B]Joseon's[/B] Turtle Ships to victory.
